name: x86-64 SSE4.2 / SSSE3 (128-bit)
description: 128-bit SIMD foundation for base64 decode. Processes 16 input bytes (12 output) per iteration.

key_instructions.purpose: Byte-level 16-entry LUT lookup. Core of nibble-decomposition decode.
Pack pairs of 6-bit values: (hi*64)+lo -> 12-bit in 16-bit lane.
Pack pairs of 12-bit values: (hi*4096)+lo -> 24-bit in 32-bit lane.
Range-based character classification (expensive, 8-9 uops). Avoid in hot loop.

base64_applicability: Minimum viable SIMD tier. 4x groups per iteration. PSHUFB+PMADDUBSW+PMADDWD pipeline processes 16 input chars to 12 output bytes. Bottleneck is PSHUFB on p5 (Skylake) limiting shuffle throughput to 1/cycle. Still achieves ~3-4x over scalar.
